stageNotes: Stage 1: input fulcrum-outdoors.shoplightspeed.com 301 -> https://www.fulcrumoutdoors.ca; <link rel=canonical> agrees.
Stage 2: Cloudflare passive on single-GET (Server: cloudflare, __cf_bm). hasWaf=false. No CAPTCHA. 8-batch/sustained DEFERRED to R2.

Stage 3: Lightspeed eCom (cdn.shoplightspeed.com x189, webshopapp.com, x-shop-id, x-developer). adapterType=generic-retail. No age-gate. Plain HTTP returns 563KB rendered product HTML -> needsPlaywright=false. Custom theme: product cards use '.product position-relative' / '.product-title' NOT '.product-element'.

Stage 4: firearm-relevant top-level cats confirmed live (firearms 333 products, shooting/optics/hunting/archery/custom-rifle-building). NO full-walk ID-dedup (BLIND). /catalog/ landing page has no product count text.
Stage 5: suffix-replace pagination. page2.html zero-overlap with page1. ?page=2 IGNORED (9/9 overlap with page1, Mistake 26 confirmed). perPage=12 observed; no perPage <select> control.

Stage 6: <select id=sortselect name=sort> options: default/popular/newest/lowest/highest/asc/desc. 3-outcome cache-bust test: default(118086894,114366279) vs ?sort=newest(118481297,118455128) vs ?sort=asc(115385178,116637820) all distinct -> HONORED. sortParam=?sort=newest, sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: no date-filter API on Lightspeed; sort=newest honored + monotonic-descending auto-increment IDs + /index.rss New-products feed -> navigate-from-watermark.
Stage 8: flat sitemap.xml (not index), 4195 total <loc>, 3285 .html product URLs. generic-product-sitemap method. Whole-catalog count (all departments).
Stage 9: candidate written BEFORE DB read per R1-blind protocol.
